test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The contingent managed to ___________ successfully.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'close the deal.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 park
 to put a vehicle in a place where it can stay for a period of time. (किसी वाहन को ऐसी जगह लगाना जहाँ वह कुछ समय के लिए रुक सके)
 
 

 close
 to change from being open to not being open; to make a successful business arrangement with someone. (खुले होने से खुले न होने में बदलने के लिए; किसी के साथ एक सफल व्यापार व्यवस्था करने के लिए)
 
 

 heal
 to make or become well again, especially after a cut or other injury. (फिर से ठीक होना या बनना, विशेष रूप से कट या अन्य चोट के बाद)
 
 

 catch
 to take hold of something, especially something that is moving through the air. (किसी चीज को पकड़ना, विशेषकर ऐसी चीज जो हवा में चलती हो)
 
 
 
 

 
• The context of the sentence is that the contingent was successful in completing the business arrangement.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "close the deal."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 
• Another example:

 
 
• *Novell expects to **close the deal** in the first quarter of 2023.​*
 
 

* *

Complete Sentence:__ *The contingent managed to __close the deal__ successfully.*
